To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the salarie of today is no longer defined only by his/her work but by all the experiences he/she can have.

the salariat's multiple identities, as well as the resources and demands of the context, influence well-being and performance at work, and that the salariat uses his/her multiple identities and resources to cope with the demands of the context and maintain well-being and performance.
multiple identities, resources, and demands are intertwined in a dynamic way and influence the individual's well-being and performance at work.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how multiple identities influence work outcomes.
the impact of multiple identities on well-being and job performance.
how multiple identities influence well-being and performance of employees.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present research contributes to the knowledge of the mechanisms underlying the relationship between multiple identities of the individual, his well-being and his individual performance at work.

the results of this thesis contribute to the development of a better understanding of the mechanisms involved in the relationship between multiple identity salient, well-being and performance at work.
the present study provides a better understanding of the role of identities in work life and the consequences of their interactions on individual well-being and performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the multiple identities of an employee influence the way he or she perceives his/her work context (resources and demands), and in return, these perceptions influence his/her individual well-being and performance.

the more a worker feels threatened by his or her environment (in this case, the work environment), the more he or she tries to counter this threat by using resources from his or her identity reservoir.
multiple identities are a source of stress, but they are also a source of resources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the salarie is a complex individual who has multiple identities and is not limited by his work.
the multiple identities of an employee are not just a sum of the parts.
identity has a dual role in the relationship between the context and the individual.
